title: Small Talk
description: The short exchanges that turn a transaction into a conversation. Low stakes, high payoff.

phrases.registerNotes: The universal opener. ね invites agreement and is what makes it sound friendly rather than declarative.

phrases.english: It's my first time in Japan.
phrases.registerNotes: Reliably produces a warm reaction and a follow-up question. A good conversation to be pulled into.
phrases.audioHint: にほんははじめてです

phrases.registerNotes: The ご prefix is honorific — you attach it when asking about the other person, never about yourself.
phrases.audioHint: ごしゅっしんはどこですか

phrases.japanese: 日本の食べ物が大好きです
phrases.romaji: Nihon no tabemono ga daisuki desu
phrases.registerNotes: 大好き is strong and warm without being awkward. Safe to use enthusiastically with strangers.
phrases.audioHint: にほんのたべものがだいすきです

phrases.japanese: オーストラリアから来ました
phrases.registerNotes: Swap the country: イギリス, アメリカ, カナダ, ドイツ, ニュージーランド.
phrases.audioHint: オーストラリアからきました

phrases.japanese: 日本語を勉強しています
phrases.registerNotes: Explains your halting Japanese as effort rather than confusion, and people invariably become more patient.
phrases.audioHint: にほんごをべんきょうしています

phrases.japanese: 写真を撮ってもいいですか
phrases.romaji: shashin o totte mo ii desu ka
phrases.registerNotes: 〜てもいいですか = 'may I…'. Worth asking in shops, temples and anywhere with people in frame.
phrases.audioHint: しゃしんをとってもいいですか

phrases.english: Your Japanese is good, isn't it.
phrases.registerNotes: Recognition only — you'll hear this constantly after saying almost nothing. It's politeness, not assessment. Deflect with いえいえ、まだまだです.
phrases.audioHint: にほんごがじょうずですね

phrases.english: I've still got a long way to go.
phrases.registerNotes: The standard modest deflection of a compliment. Accepting praise directly reads as immodest, so this is the expected move.
phrases.animeNote: Anime characters accept compliments far more directly than real speakers do. This deflection is the actual convention.

phrases.registerNotes: Warm way to close an interaction or a day out. Past tense of 楽しい.
